material.acceptance_criteria: A committed baseline file records p50, p90 and p99 for a fixed scenario, and a CI step fails when a fresh run's p99 exceeds the baseline by more than a stated margin.
material.description: rust/crates/server/src/budget.rs prints tick-time p50, p90, p99 and max every 80 ticks. The tick-budget job in .github/workflows/ci.yml checks only the line format and runs with a 1 us budget or a 20 ms budget. Nothing compares percentiles to a stored baseline, so a slowdown in the sim tick cannot fail CI.
material.resolution: Latency gate: ceiling 3000 us from one measured run (p99 1000 us); step fails when p99 exceeds the ceiling; zero-ceiling self-check refused. Caveats: single-sample baseline; p99 reported at 1 ms bucket resolution.
material.subject: Tick percentiles are logged but no committed baseline gates regressions in CI
material.witness_plan: CI step runs oscraftd --ticks 2000 --tick-budget-us 20000 on a fixed --data image, parses the final tick-time line, and compares p99_us against the committed baseline with the margin; the step fails on regression and the baseline is updated by an explicit commit.
